subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit policy notice remain open, or should maintainers unpin and close it now that docs and automation are aligned?
rationale: The source behavior is already aligned, but a maintainer intentionally reopened and pinned the issue after that work, so automation should not override the visibility decision.

options.title: Keep pinned notice open
options.body: Preserves the current maintainer signal and keeps the policy visible to contributors while source docs and automation remain synchronized.

options.title: Unpin and close
options.body: Treats CONTRIBUTING.md plus Barnacle/Labeler as the canonical policy surfaces and removes the issue from the open queue.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Preserves the current maintainer signal and keeps the policy visible to contributors while source docs and automation remain synchronized.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the 20-cap title update and later pinned/reopened the live issue.
